definition_id_assignment.policy: Persist each key-to-id mapping. Allocate new rows from the next unused id in this namespace. Never renumber or reuse; retain removed ids as tombstones.

locale_match_report.matching: Exact text first. If absent, NFKC + casefold + punctuation-to-space + whitespace collapse. Assign only a unique candidate; ambiguous and unmatched rows stay null.

trophy_crosswalk.provenance: Wiki reward point/name text joined to first-party AchievementTrophies.txt rows and their locale names; this is a catalogue crosswalk, not a recovered per-achievement packet assignment.
trophy_crosswalk.method: Unique POINT_VALUE for 5, 10, 15, 25, and 40 points; exact Wonderous label plus the client locale name for 0 points.

counter_binding_report.provenance: (R) Mapping of wiki text onto current Rust progression outputs; these keys are data bindings, not recovered original server bindings.
counter_binding_report.job_rank_semantics: One increment per rank increase from initial rank 1; thresholds are target rank minus 1.
counter_binding_report.quest_completed_count_semantics: One increment per accepted completed quest; threshold is the wiki count.
counter_binding_report.unresolved_reason: Remaining rows need per-questline, dungeon, minigame/TCG, item-set, PvP, or event-specific evidence and stable event keys.

image_report.reason: Achievement IconId is a server-sent per-achievement field; no client definition table or capture mapped it. Trophy image_set_id is available on the 10 client trophy rows and joins through reward.client_trophy_id.

client_category_locale_sentinels.reason: First-party category resource uses 0 where no locale string is supplied; zero is not a key in the extracted locale table.
